sentences.zh: 在太空历经七十年。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Over the past few years, members of the Supreme Court's liberal minority have voted over and over again to oppose the court's conservative majority.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，最高法院自由派少数派的成员一次又一次地投票，反对法院的保守派多数派。

sentences.en: offering what might look like a united front of resistance.
sentences.zh: 展现出看似团结一致的抵抗阵线。

sentences.en: But behind the scenes, my colleague Jody Cantor has uncovered growing tensions between those liberal justices over the best way to fight back.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，我的同事乔迪·坎托发现，这些自由派大法官在如何进行反击的最佳方式上，分歧日益加剧。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, December 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月10日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jody.
sentences.zh: 乔迪。

sentences.en: Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔。

sentences.en: Good to have you back in the studio.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你回到演播室。

sentences.en: Great to be back with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你在一起。

sentences.en: You are very well along in a line of reporting that, in my estimation, has pulled back the curtain on the unseen decision-making that goes on
sentences.zh: 你的报道已经推进得很深，在我看来，它拉开了那些不为人知的决策过程的帷幕

sentences.en: among the nine justices of the Supreme Court at a hugely consequential moment for the court.
sentences.zh: 这些决策发生在最高法院九位大法官之间，正值法院面临极具影响力的关键时刻。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We want to understand not only the legal decisions they're making, but we're asking, who are these nine people who hold this much power,
sentences.zh: 我们不仅想了解他们做出的法律裁决，还要探究：这九位手握如此大权的人究竟是谁，

sentences.en: and how do they function together as a body?
sentences.zh: 他们作为一个集体是如何运作的？

sentences.en: How do they influence one another?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何互相影响的？

sentences.en: How does power flow inside the Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 权力在最高法院内部是如何流动的？

sentences.en: And we're doing it at a time when the court is deciding these major questions about how much power President Trump will have.
sentences.zh: 而我们做这一切正值法院在裁决这些重大问题，关于特朗普总统将拥有多少权力。

sentences.en: Who can he fire?
sentences.zh: 他可以解雇谁？

sentences.en: Can he go around Congress to defund an agency?
sentences.zh: 他能否绕过国会去削减某个机构的资金？

sentences.en: Can he end birthright citizenship?
sentences.zh: 他能否终结出生公民权？

sentences.en: What is going to happen to his tariffs program?
sentences.zh: 他的关税计划将会怎样？

sentences.en: The court is literally looking into almost all those questions.
sentences.zh: 法院实际上正在审视几乎所有这些问题。

sentences.en: They're determining the contours of his power.
sentences.zh: 他们在划定他权力的边界。

sentences.en: And the liberal justices, who, as you know, are badly outnumbered, see President Trump as a threat to the constitutional order.
sentences.zh: 而正如你所知，自由派大法官在人数上处于绝对劣势，他们将特朗普总统视为对宪政秩序的威胁。

sentences.en: And they want to persuade their conservative colleagues of that point of view.
sentences.zh: 他们希望说服保守派同僚接受这种观点。

sentences.en: No simple task.
sentences.zh: 绝非易事。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: This is a wing of the court that holds very little power right now, and it's trying to use what little power it has to mitigate the rightward lurch of the court.
sentences.zh: 法院的这个派别目前掌握的权力极小，它正试图利用这点微末的权力来缓解法院向右倾斜的趋势。

sentences.en: But the liberal justices are split on the best way to do that.
sentences.zh: 但自由派大法官们对于如何做到这一点存在分歧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Based on your reporting, what exactly does this split on the left look like?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，左翼内部的这种分歧究竟是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, the starkest split is between Justice Elena Kagan and Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson,
sentences.zh: 嗯，最鲜明的分歧存在于埃琳娜·卡根大法官和克坦吉·布朗·杰克逊大法官之间，

sentences.en: who have taken very different approaches to countering the conservative dominance of the court.
sentences.zh: 她们采取了截然不同的方法来对抗法院的保守派主导地位。

sentences.en: And you see a real tension between their two different approaches emerging.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，她们两种不同方法之间出现了真正的紧张关系。

sentences.en: And where should we begin to tell that story?
sentences.zh: 我们该从哪里开始讲述这个故事呢？

sentences.en: Well, let's go back to the first moment when one of these people arrives at the court.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们回到这些人中有一人首次来到法院的那个时刻。

sentences.en: Justice Elena Kagan, appointed in 2010 by President Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 埃琳娜·卡根大法官，于2010年由贝拉克·奥巴马总统任命。

sentences.en: Now, she is appointed specifically to be a diplomat.
sentences.zh: 现在，她被任命专门充当外交官。

sentences.en: Interestingly, I found out she was recommended to President Obama by Justice Antonin Scalia.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我发现安东宁·斯卡利亚大法官曾向奥巴马总统推荐过她。

sentences.en: So you've got the kind of—
sentences.zh: 所以你会发现这种——

sentences.en: A very conservative justice recommending a pretty progressive one.
sentences.zh: 一位非常保守的大法官推荐了一位相当进步的大法官。

sentences.en: Oh, you've got this duke of conservative legal thought saying, send us someone smart.
sentences.zh: 哦，保守派法律思想界的泰斗在说，给我们派个聪明人来。

sentences.en: Send us Elena Kagan.
sentences.zh: 给我们派埃琳娜·卡根来。

sentences.en: Send us a former dean of Harvard Law.
sentences.zh: 派一位哈佛法学院的前院长来。

sentences.en: Who had a reputation for treating conservatives well, inviting them in, being a good diplomat at Harvard Law School, getting conservative faculty appointed.
sentences.zh: 她以善待保守派、邀请他们加入、在哈佛法学院长袖善舞、促成保守派教员的任命而闻名。

sentences.en: And at the time that she gets to the court, what is its ideological mix looking like and what kind of decisions are coming out of that court?
sentences.zh: 在她进入法院时，那里的意识形态组合是怎样的，那个法院做出了什么样的裁决？

sentences.en: Well, it's a 5-4 court.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个5比4的法院。

sentences.en: It leans conservative, but not by that much.
sentences.zh: 它倾向于保守，但并没有那么严重。

sentences.en: And right at the center, you've got Justice Anthony Kennedy, who was appointed by a Republican but sometimes voted with his liberal colleagues.
sentences.zh: 正处于中心位置的是安东尼·肯尼迪大法官，他由共和党人任命，但有时会与他的自由派同僚投相同的票。

sentences.en: And the Chief Justice, John Roberts, definitely conservative but had a desire to be independent.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨，绝对是保守派，但有一种保持独立的愿望。

sentences.en: So a conservative-leaning court where surprising things can happen.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个倾向保守的法院，却可能发生令人惊讶的事情。

sentences.en: Things were still up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 一切都还是未知数。

sentences.en: And so she comes to the court, and she's never been a judge before.
sentences.zh: 因此她来到法院，而且她以前从未当过法官。

sentences.en: But she's very strategic, and she comes up with a methodology of her own for how to operate on a 5-4 court.
sentences.zh: 但她非常富有战略眼光，并在一个5比4的法院里摸索出了一套属于自己的运作方法论。

sentences.en: I love the stuff where we can all really engage each other, try to persuade each other.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那种我们所有人都能真正地相互交流、试图说服彼此的事情。

sentences.en: Where it's an uphill battle for her, but she has some chance of prevailing.
sentences.zh: 对她来说这是一场硬仗，但她有一些获胜的可能。

sentences.en: And we're an institution, we're a very collegial institution, notwithstanding the fact we have all these opportunities for disagreement.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个机构，我们是一个非常讲究同事精神的机构，尽管我们有这么多产生分歧的机会。

sentences.en: And her methodology is to form relationships and look for areas of agreement.
sentences.zh: 她的方法论是建立关系并寻找共识领域。

sentences.en: So she becomes a confidant of Chief Justice Roberts.
sentences.zh: 因此她成了首席大法官罗伯茨的知己。

sentences.en: Who's part of the conservative majority.
sentences.zh: 而罗伯茨是保守派多数派的一员。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She also keeps a really close eye on Justice Kennedy.
sentences.zh: 她还密切关注肯尼迪大法官。

sentences.en: She is following his moods, his concerns, his inclinations.
sentences.zh: 她在揣摩他的情绪、他的担忧、他的倾向。

sentences.en: And people who worked with them at the time even joked to me that she knew what he had for breakfast every morning.
sentences.zh: 当时与他们共事的人甚至开玩笑地告诉我，她连他每天早上吃什么都知道。

sentences.en: There are some things that we do where almost nobody is persuadable.
sentences.zh: 我们做的某些事情是几乎没人能被说服的。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of things we do where folks are.
sentences.zh: 但我们做的许多事情，人们是可以被说服的。

sentences.en: She took notes on what her colleagues thought in conference meetings.
sentences.zh: 她在闭门会议上记下同僚们的想法。

sentences.en: There are instrumental reasons, for sure, to get along with everybody and to maintain good relations with everybody.
sentences.zh: 当然，与所有人相处并与所有人保持良好关系是有着现实考量的。

sentences.en: And what she's trying to do is find common ground with them, build consensus.
sentences.zh: 她试图做的是与他们寻找共同点，建立共识。

sentences.en: These questions matter, and they're important.
sentences.zh: 这些问题很重要，它们意义重大。

sentences.en: and I often have strong views about them.
sentences.zh: 而且我经常对它们持有强烈的看法。

sentences.en: And she's trying to win outright, which she does in some cases.
sentences.zh: 她试图彻底赢得胜利，在某些情况下她确实做到了。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: So, for example, President Obama's health care law was challenged over and over by conservatives, and several times the cases made it up to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，奥巴马总统的医疗法案一再遭到保守派的挑战，这些案件曾数次闹到最高法院。

sentences.en: And at least in two of those cases, it was close.
sentences.zh: 至少在其中两个案件中，情况非常胶着。

sentences.en: People did not know which way it was going to go.
sentences.zh: 人们不知道结果会倒向哪一边。

sentences.en: And the law survived in part because Justice Kagan and others on the court helped build liberal and conservative coalitions.
sentences.zh: 这项法案得以存活，部分原因在于卡根大法官和法院里的其他人帮忙构建了自由派和保守派的联盟。

sentences.en: So let's call those, on balance, victories for liberals.
sentences.zh: 所以，总的来说，让我们把这些称为自由派的胜利。

sentences.en: They were complicated, but they were victories.
sentences.zh: 它们很复杂，但确实是胜利。

sentences.en: That she helped achieve.
sentences.zh: 这是她协助取得的成果。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And she's also doing this other thing, which is winning by losing.
sentences.zh: 她还在做另一件事，那就是虽败犹荣。

sentences.en: How does that work?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Well, now within a particular case, there is often an ability to compromise things out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在特定案件中，通常有能力通过妥协来解决问题。

sentences.en: If you're a Supreme Court justice, and if you're a Supreme Court justice in the minority,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名最高法院大法官，而且是一名处于少数派的最高法院大法官，

sentences.en: and if you can't win, what you want to do is make the outcome less bad from your perspective.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法取胜，你想做的是从你的角度让结果不那么糟糕。

sentences.en: Which, you know, the way that often happens in the courts business is by sort of redefining issues a little bit.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在法院事务中这通常发生的方式是稍微重新定义一些议题。

sentences.en: Like, if you narrow the issues, it tends to be that you'll have greater consensus.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你缩小争议焦点，往往会达成更大的共识。

sentences.en: People who worked with her said that she would say things in private like, let's make this opinion 30% better.
sentences.zh: 与她共事过的人说，她会在私下里说这样的话：让我们把这份判决书写得好30%。

sentences.en: You have to keep talking.
sentences.zh: 你必须继续对话。

sentences.en: And you have to find ways of, like, readjusting the issue or of convincing each other.
sentences.zh: 你必须找到诸如重新调整议题或互相说服的方法。

sentences.en: So there's this 2018 case called Masterpiece Cake Shop.
sentences.zh: 所以有一个2018年的案件叫“杰作蛋糕店”。

sentences.en: This is the Colorado, yes, the Colorado cake baker case.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个科罗拉多州，对，科罗拉多州蛋糕店的案件。

sentences.en: And there's a baker who says, because of my religious beliefs, I should not be required to bake cakes.
sentences.zh: 有个蛋糕师说，由于我的宗教信仰，我不应该被要求做蛋糕。

sentences.en: For a same-sex wedding.
sentences.zh: 为同性婚礼制作蛋糕。

sentences.en: For a same-sex wedding.
sentences.zh: 为同性婚礼制作蛋糕。

sentences.en: So what happened in this case is that it looked like a loss for liberals.
sentences.zh: 所以这个案件发生的情况是，它看起来像是自由派的失利。

sentences.en: The court decided in the baker's favor.
sentences.zh: 法院做出了有利于蛋糕师的判决。

sentences.en: However, thanks to Kagan and others behind the scenes, they decided on grounds so narrow that the result was pretty meaningless.
sentences.zh: 然而，多亏了幕后的卡根和其他人，他们的裁决依据是如此狭隘，以至于结果几乎没有什么意义。

sentences.en: The whole point of the Supreme Court is to set precedent.
sentences.zh: 最高法院的全部意义在于确立先例。

sentences.en: That applies broadly to cases that are comparable.
sentences.zh: 这广泛适用于类似的案件。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in this case, it was such a restricted decision that it barely applied to others.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件中，这是一个极其受限的判决，几乎不适用于其他案件。

sentences.en: It was a very hollow victory for conservatives.
sentences.zh: 对保守派来说，这是一场非常空洞的胜利。

sentences.en: So in this era of a five to four court where Kagan and the liberals know for the most part they're going to lose the biggest cases,
sentences.zh: 所以在这样一个5比4的法院时代，卡根和自由派大体上知道他们会在最大的案件中输掉，

sentences.en: she has clearly found a way to make legal lemonade out of lemons.
sentences.zh: 她显然已经找到了化柠檬为柠檬水的方法。

sentences.en: She's getting business done.
sentences.zh: 她把事情办成了。

sentences.en: It's an atmosphere in which a dealmaker can get some traction.
sentences.zh: 这是一个交易高手能够游刃有余的氛围。

sentences.en: And that requires sacrifice, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这需要牺牲。

sentences.en: it requires discipline because Justice Kagan did object to some of the court's decisions, and she is fully capable of punching hard.
sentences.zh: 这需要纪律，因为卡根大法官确实反对过法院的一些判决，而且她完全有能力狠狠回击。

sentences.en: And there are a couple of decisions in which she lets loose on the court.
sentences.zh: 有几个判决中她对法院毫不客气。

sentences.en: But for the most part, she decides that it doesn't serve her mission.
sentences.zh: 但大多数时候，她认为这无助于她的使命。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you're Justice Kagan and you want to keep getting business done with a conservative majority, a little bit of honey is going to go a long way.
sentences.zh: 如果你是卡根大法官，并且你想继续与保守派多数派合作把事情办成，一点甜头会大有帮助。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: These people serve for decades together.
sentences.zh: 这些人在一起供职长达几十年。

sentences.en: A slight can last a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 一次冷落可能会持续一辈子。

sentences.en: And in fact, in my reporting, I even found an example where she wrote a very strenuous dissent.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在我的报道中，我甚至发现了一个例子，她写了一份措辞非常强烈的异议意见。

sentences.en: Taken.
sentences.zh: 收到。

sentences.en: Disagreeing exactly with the court's decision and with the chief justice's opinion, but she took lines out of it her original draft really had gone hard after the chief justice
sentences.zh: 完全不同意法院的裁决以及首席大法官的意见，但她删掉了其中的一些行——她最初的草稿确实对首席大法官下了狠手——

sentences.en: but before the decision became public she softened it she took those lines out so that's the approach
sentences.zh: 但在裁决公开之前，她软化了语气，删掉了那些行，所以这就是卡根大法官采取的方法：

sentences.en: that justice kagan takes keep the peace make deals and then about a decade into her service
sentences.zh: 保持和平，达成交易，然后在大约她履职十年左右时，

sentences.en: Everything changes.
sentences.zh: 一切都变了。

sentences.en: All right, we have breaking news right now.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们现在有突发新闻。

sentences.en: Ruth Bader Ginsburg has passed away.
sentences.zh: 露丝·巴德·金斯布里奇去世了。

sentences.en: In September of 2020, Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg dies.
sentences.zh: 2020年9月，露丝·巴德·金斯伯格大法官去世。

sentences.en: A loss rocking the political universe tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚这一损失震撼了整个政治界。

sentences.en: The battle lines over the court's future already being drawn.
sentences.zh: 围绕法院未来的战线已经拉开。

sentences.en: Today it is my honor to nominate one of our nation's most brilliant and gifted legal minds to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 今天，我很荣幸提名我们国家最才华横溢、最有天赋的法律头脑之一进入最高法院。

sentences.en: She is quickly replaced, as we remember, by Justice Amy Coney Barrett.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所记得的，她很快被艾米·科尼·巴雷特大法官所取代。

sentences.en: There's only been 114 Supreme Court justices in history, so every one is important.

sentences.zh: 因此在她的意见书中，她经常是在对公众讲话。

sentences.en: than justice Kagan of how to be an effective justice she feels she has to be blunt you know like associates of hers have described her thinking to me and her strategy is deliberate
sentences.zh: 她在说，你们需要了解这件事。

sentences.en: she has basically reasoned that on a 6-3 court she's not going to persuade her colleagues and
sentences.zh: 我想提高你们的意识。

sentences.en: any gains that would be exacted would be so small that they wouldn't be worth the price of staying silent.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这令人不安。

sentences.en: And so in her opinions, she's often speaking to the public.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是一种为了历史而写作的方式，你押注于即使没有立即发生任何事情，它也会带来长期的改变。

sentences.en: She's saying, you need to know about this.
sentences.zh: 然后在特朗普重新上台之后，当她看到特朗普总统的一系列法律行动时，她决定必须就正在发生的事情向公众发出警告。

sentences.en: I want to raise your awareness.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始看到杰克逊大法官发表这样的意见书：她从体制内部发声，说出这样的话：这个法院受制于金钱利益。

sentences.en: I find this troubling.
sentences.zh: 她说这个法院正在促成我们的集体消亡。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's a kind of writing for history in which you're betting that even if nothing happens immediately, it will result in long-term change.
sentences.zh: 自从特朗普总统重新上台以来，她在判决书中的信息听起来就像是在说，

sentences.en: And then after Trump gets back into office and she sees the barrage of President Trump's legal actions, she decides she has to warn the public about what's happening.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在最高法院内部，我很清楚这些同事。

sentences.en: And so we start seeing these opinions from Justice Jackson in which she's writing from inside the House and she's saying things like, this court is beholden to moneyed interests.
sentences.zh: 翻译完成

sentences.en: She says this court is enabling our collective demise.
sentences.zh: 翻译完成

sentences.en: Her message in opinions since President Trump has gotten back into office sound to me like she's saying,
sentences.zh: 翻译完成

sentences.en: I'm sitting here inside the Supreme Court and I know these colleagues.
sentences.zh: 翻译完成

sentences.en: I see what's going on on the inside and it is really bad.
sentences.zh: 我看到了内部正在发生的情况，情况真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: And how is this being received by Kagan, given her approach?
sentences.zh: 卡根法官考虑到她的方法，对这件事作何反应？

sentences.en: Things start to get tense among the liberal justices.
sentences.zh: 自由派大法官之间的气氛开始变得紧张。

sentences.en: There is just this existential dilemma and this split in strategy.
sentences.zh: 这里确实存在着一种存在主义困境和策略上的分歧。

sentences.en: Because you have to realize that Justice Jackson going for it is potentially very threatening to Justice Kagan's strategy.
sentences.zh: 因为你必须意识到，杰克逊大法官全力以赴的做法可能会对卡根法官的策略构成极大的威胁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Look, in practical terms, the only way for liberals to win on this court is for Justice Barrett and Chief Justice Roberts to vote with them.
sentences.zh: 听着，从实际角度来看，自由派在这个最高法院获胜的唯一途径，就是巴雷特大法官和罗伯茨首席大法官与他们投赞成票。

sentences.en: So the risk that Justice Jackson is taking is that she could alienate these people and then the liberals don't have any chance at all.
sentences.zh: 因此，杰克逊大法官冒的风险是，她可能会疏远这些人，那样的话，自由派就彻底没有机会了。

sentences.en: That is not the path to Kagan's metaphorical 30 percent better ruling.
sentences.zh: 这可不是卡根所说的那种能带来百分之三十改善的裁决之路。

sentences.en: No, it's not.
sentences.zh: 不，并不是。

sentences.en: But the Jacksonites, and remember that Justice Jackson has a lot of adherents who believe that what she's doing is very important.
sentences.zh: 但杰克逊的支持者们——记住杰克逊大法官有很多拥趸，他们坚信她正在做的事情非常重要——

sentences.en: What they would say is, Justice Kagan, what are you holding back for?
sentences.zh: 他们会说：卡根法官，你到底在有所保留什么？

sentences.en: What do you think you're going to gain from this?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你从中能得到什么好处？

sentences.en: And they have some evidence to back up their position.
sentences.zh: 而且他们有一些证据来支持自己的立场。

sentences.en: Such as what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: For example, go back to Colorado and the question of who's going to serve these gay couples who want to get married.
sentences.zh: 比如，回想一下科罗拉多州的那个案子，关于谁来为那些想要结婚的同性恋夫妇提供服务的问题。

sentences.en: The Baker case.
sentences.zh: 蛋糕店老板案。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没准。

sentences.en: Another case comes along.
sentences.zh: 另一个案子出现了。

sentences.en: This is like a carbon copy of the Baker case, except that it's a graphic designer this time who doesn't want to make wedding websites and invitations for gay couples.
sentences.zh: 这就像是蛋糕店老板案的翻版，只不过这次是一个平面设计师，她不想为同性恋夫妇制作婚礼网站和请柬。

sentences.en: And so this time, the conservatives just win full out, and that little compromise is wiped away.
sentences.zh: 所以这一次，保守派大获全胜，那个小小的妥协烟消云散了。

sentences.en: And the principle is established that, yes, a religious person can refuse to serve a gay couple because it doesn't comport with that person's religious beliefs.
sentences.zh: 并且确立了这样一项原则：是的，宗教人士可以拒绝为同性恋夫妇服务，因为这不符合该人士的宗教信仰。

sentences.en: So basically, this would be fuel for Justice Jackson's argument of what is the point of pretending that we're going to get something from this conservative majority?
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这将为杰克逊大法官的论点提供弹药，即：我们假装能从这个保守派多数派那里得到些什么，到底有什么意义？

sentences.en: You're not getting your 30 percent because this court just wiped out the 30 percent you even thought you got back in 2018.
sentences.zh: 你根本得不到你那百分之三十的改善，因为这个法院刚刚抹去了你在2018年甚至以为自己争取到的那百分之三十。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But my sources debated this, to be honest, again and again, because there were Kaganite sources who said Justice Kagan won five years of protection for these gay couples.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，我的消息人士对此进行了反复辩论，因为卡根派的消息人士表示，卡根法官为这些同性恋夫妇争取到了五年的保护期。

sentences.en: Don't knock it.
sentences.zh: 别看不起这个。

sentences.en: That's a lot of real people who benefited from this decision.
sentences.zh: 有许多真实的人从这项裁决中受益了。

sentences.en: And on top of that, Justice Kagan has still gained some victories on the 6-3 court.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，卡根法官在这个六比三的最高法院里仍然取得了一些胜利。

sentences.en: Last term, she had a win on federal agency power, and she won three votes from the center of the court.
sentences.zh: 在上个审判期，她在联邦机构权力问题上赢了一场，并争取到了来自法院中间派的三张选票。

sentences.en: Three votes from the chief justice, Justice Kavanaugh, Justice Barrett.
sentences.zh: 来自首席大法官、卡瓦诺大法官、巴雷特大法官的三张选票。

sentences.en: So there is still potentially some case for compromise.
sentences.zh: 所以，寻求妥协仍然在某种程度上是有可能的。

sentences.en: So you can go, I mean, the liberal law arati, the law professors, the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以去，我是说，那些自由派的法律精英、法学教授、最高法院……

sentences.en: That's a new phrase.
sentences.zh: 这是一个新词。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court advocates, they are lit up by this question of what is the best strategy.
sentences.zh: 最高法院的诉讼律师们，他们对“什么是最佳策略”这个问题感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: And then in the most important case of last term, Justice Jackson finds herself in a real clash with Justice Barrett.
sentences.zh: 然后在上个审判期最重要的一个案子中，杰克逊大法官发现自己与巴雷特大法官发生了真正的冲突。

sentences.en: This was a case called Trump v.
sentences.zh: 这是一个名为“特朗普诉……案”的案子——

sentences.en: Casa, in which the court decided that federal judges could no longer issue nationwide injunctions.
sentences.zh: 在这个案子中，法院裁定联邦法官不再有权发布全国性的禁令。

sentences.en: And by doing that, they're really limiting the judiciary's power to stand up to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，他们确实限制了司法部门对抗特朗普总统的权力。

sentences.en: And so what happens in those opinions is that Justice Barrett and Justice Jackson have a giant public fight.
sentences.zh: 所以在这些判决意见中发生的情况是，巴雷特大法官和杰克逊大法官爆发了一场巨大的公开争论。

sentences.en: fight.
sentences.zh: 争论。

sentences.en: Justice Jackson, in her dissent, writes that, quote, eventually executive power will become completely uncontainable and our beloved constitutional republic will be no more.
sentences.zh: 杰克逊大法官在她的反对意见中写道，引述：“最终，行政权力将变得完全无法控制，我们深爱的宪政共和国也将不复存在。”

sentences.en: And she signs off by saying, with deep disillusionment, I dissent.
sentences.zh: 她在结尾写道：“怀着深深的幻灭感，我表示反对。”

sentences.en: And those words are a direct criticism of Justice Barrett, who has written the majority opinion for the conservatives.
sentences.zh: 这些话是对巴雷特大法官的直接批评，后者曾为保守派撰写了多数意见书。

sentences.en: And Justice Barrett, who is usually a pretty mild writer, she hits back in the opinions.
sentences.zh: 而一向文风较为温和的巴雷特大法官，在意见书中进行了回击。

sentences.en: She says, we're not even going to consider some of what Justice Jackson says here.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我们甚至不会去考虑杰克逊大法官在这里所说的一些言论。”

sentences.en: So this kind of brings to the fore the fear we mentioned, which is that Justice Jackson could alienate Justice Barrett and the
sentences.zh: 因此，这把我们之前提到过的担忧推到了风口浪尖，也就是杰克逊大法官可能会疏远巴雷特大法官和

sentences.en: Chief Justice.
sentences.zh: 首席大法官。

sentences.en: So what we're seeing, clearly, is both approaches finding their limits in this moment.
sentences.zh: 所以我们显然看到，这两种方法在此时都遇到了各自的局限。

sentences.en: Kagan's compromises are getting washed away by the sheer severity of the court's rightward turn, and Jackson's sharply worded dissents are beginning to alienate the conservatives
sentences.zh: 卡agan的妥协正在被最高法院严重右倾的浪潮冲刷殆尽，而杰克逊措辞尖锐的异议也开始疏远保守派

sentences.en: in a way that might even further marginalize the court's liberals.
sentences.zh: 这种方式甚至可能会进一步边缘化法院中的自由派。

sentences.en: So I guess the question then becomes, which of these strategies is most likely to work out in the longer term?
sentences.zh: 所以我想问题就在于，从长远来看，哪种策略最有可能奏效？

sentences.en: Yes, that is certainly a debate.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实是一个争论焦点。

sentences.en: Justice Jackson appears to have chosen a stance and have chosen a tone, and maybe that will change, but at least recently, she's been very forceful.
sentences.zh: 杰克逊大法官似乎已经选择了一种立场和基调，也许这会改变，但至少在最近，她的态度非常强势。

sentences.en: The justice who really has a decision to make is Justice Kagan, because remember,
sentences.zh: 真正需要做决定的大法官是卡agan，因为记住，

sentences.en: However, she is the one who's agonized all these years over whether she's doing it right.
sentences.zh: 然而，她正是多年来一直为自己做得是否正确而感到痛苦的人。

sentences.en: People close to her who saw her over the summer, they said she was despondent about what was going on, that she is really worried about the state of the country and the law.
sentences.zh: 夏天见过她的身边人士说，她对发生的事情感到沮丧，她真的在为国家和法律的现状感到担忧。

sentences.en: Right now, Michael, as we sit here, this is when the Supreme Court is making the real lasting decisions about President Trump's power.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，就在此时此刻，正当我们坐在这里讨论时，最高法院正在做出关于特朗普总统权力的真正持久的决定。

sentences.en: The decisions from last term were very consequential.
sentences.zh: 上个学期的裁决非常重要。

sentences.en: They were also mostly temporary.
sentences.zh: 而且它们大多是临时的。

sentences.en: So the question—
sentences.zh: 所以问题是——

sentences.en: Cans were kicked down the road to now.
sentences.zh: 问题一直拖延到了现在。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the question is, does Justice Jackson remain on this path?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，杰克逊大法官会继续这条道路吗？

sentences.en: And for Justice Kagan, who does she ultimately want to be?
sentences.zh: 而对于卡agan大法官来说，她最终想成为什么样的人？

sentences.en: And how will the strategic decisions by both of these justices affect how much power President
sentences.zh: 这两位大法官的战略决策将如何影响总统最终获得的权力大小？

sentences.en: Trump ultimately gets?
sentences.zh: 特朗普最终获得了多少权力？

sentences.en: And what will that mean for the court, the country, and the future of our democracy?
sentences.zh: 这对于法院、国家以及我们民主的未来意味着什么？

sentences.zh: 乔迪，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Michael, it's always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，与你交流总是很高兴。

sentences.zh: 普里茨克签署了一项法律，限制在州法院外进行移民执法，限制可以提供给移民特工的信息，

sentences.zh: 并使该州居民在认为自己的权利受到侵害时，更容易起诉移民特工。

sentences.en: But it's unclear if the Trump administration will observe the new law.
sentences.zh: 但目前尚不清楚特朗普政府是否会遵守这项新法律。

sentences.en: In response to it, the Department of Homeland Security said that arresting immigrants in courthouses is legal and, quote, is common sense.
